cases.request: Review this React Intl message: `Vesting {startDate} – {endDate}`. Both placeholders receive strings produced separately by `intl.formatDate`.
Review this React Intl message: `Vesting ends {date, date, ::yyyyMMdd}`. `date` is a raw `Date`, and the description says `Date when the vesting period ends`.
Review this React Intl message: `{renewalPrice} ({discountPercentage} off)`. Both placeholders receive raw numbers. `renewalPrice` is USD and `discountPercentage` is `0.2` for 20 percent.

Review this React Intl message: `{renewalPrice, number, ::currency/USD} ({discount, number, ::percent} off)`. Values are raw numbers, discount is `0.2`, and the description explains this is a renewal price followed by its discount.
Review this React Intl message: `<regularPrice></regularPrice> <discountedPrice></discountedPrice> per month`. Both tags receive functions that return `<FormattedNumber>` elements.
Review this React Intl message: `Save now to get {discount, number, ::percent} off`. `strong` wraps chunks in ``, and `discount` is the raw number `0.2`.
Review this message: `{brand} helps you find answers.` The runtime always passes the fixed product name `Northstar`; this is not tenant data.
Review the source message `Open`. It has no description, screenshot, call site, target locale, or other UI context.
